about: Where every bough spray of the copper beech stands, written by source-art/models/theatre/beech_crown.py. In the ride's own axes (x, y up, z) from the tree's foot. One row a spray: x, y, z of its foot; quaternion x, y, z, w; size; kind (index into kinds: beech_spray_<kind>.glb); colour (index into colours); moon (0..1: how much of the moon reaches it through the crown); fire (0..1: how much of the chandelier's light reaches it through the crown); open (0..1: how open it is to the room all round); a number of its own; depth (0 at the shell of its mass .. 1 at its heart); mass (index into masses). masses: name, x, y, z, radius, ring (1 the skirt that hangs to 15 m .. 7 the top above the roof; 0: on the great limb).
